messages:
Chris P.: quick sync — Q3/Q4 infra roadmap decisions needed for GPU procurement + region expansion. need SKU mix, commit windows, and fallback policy by end of week.
Dana: are we still planning a phased A100 -> H100 refresh or go straight H100 for new EU regions?
Lee: customer asks are pushing EU private deployments (healthcare & fintech). that likely requires EU racks + KMS integration timeline.
Sam: procurement update: vendor confirmed H100 availability but lead time is 6–10 weeks depending on order size. price is firm for Q3 commits.
Maria: from OKR side we have utilization target 92% for Q4, SLOs require 99.9% median latency. if we overcommit to reserve capacity we hurt unit economics.
Chris P.: proposal: commit to 6 racks H100 in eu-west-1 for Q4, reserve 2 racks as cold spares for failover or heavy-tail bursts. keep some g5 spot/ondemand in early ramp.
Dana: +1 to mix, but can we reduce cold spares to 1 if we buy insurance/contract with vendor for expedited shipment?
Sam: vendor offered expedited shipping at +12% cost, 2–3 week window. that would let us cut spares but increases cost.
Lee: also need to account for Private deploy customers wanting dedicated HW. suggest we reserve 1 rack per enterprise customer for first 3 customers onboarded.
Maria: decision tradeoff: reserve racks for dedicated private customers vs. maximize shared capacity. OKR alignment leans toward higher utilization — prefer minimal dedicated reservations unless contractually required.
Chris P.: action item: Dana to surface list of pending enterprise contracts that require dedicated racks. Sam to confirm lead times & expedited cost in writing. Maria to run utilization sims with 1 vs 2 dedicated racks.
Dana: will do, sending list by EOD today.
Sam: I'll push vendor cost/leadtime summary:
```
H100-80GB x 8 racks 
leadtime: 6 weeks standard / 2-3 weeks expedited (+12%)
min order: 1 rack
vendor: TitanCompute.
```
Maria: i'll run sims, but initial thought: with 6 racks + 1 spare + 2 ded for customers we hit ~88–90% utilization average; without dedicated reserves we can reach 93–94%.
Chris P.: can ops define fallback: if vendor slips beyond 10 weeks, we fallback to: 1) burst on hosted spot GPUs (g5/higher cost), 2) delay non-critical private rollout by 6 weeks, 3) negotiate temporary reserved instances with cloud partner.
Lee: noted. also need to align KMS/HSM timeline — security team needs 4 weeks to validate hardware HSM integration in eu-west-1.
Dana: filing procurement request now, tagging security for KMS check. @security please prioritize review. :pray:
ops-bot: procurement form submitted by Dana at 2005123460 — request ID PR-4721.
Chris P.: decision checkpoint: if vendor confirms 6wk leadtime by Thursday, we commit to 6 racks H100 + 1 spare. if vendor still uncertain we reduce to 4 racks and use cloud burst plan.
Maria: agreed. i'll update OKR doc with both scenarios and include cost delta.
Dana: timeline note — payment terms require 30% deposit on commit, finance needs final approval. cc @finance.
Chris P.: great. next sync Friday 10am to lock numbers. thanks all. :thumbsup:
